title: Reason Code 68: outside the policy's day and time restrictions
plain_english: The request matched a network policy that has a Day and Time Restrictions constraint, and the current time is outside the allowed window. The account and credentials are fine.

any: does not have permission to access the network on this day at this time

causes.cause: The matching network policy restricts days and times.
causes.next_check: NPS console > Network Policies > the policy named in the event > Constraints > Day and Time Restrictions; check the NPS server's time zone too.
